alignments.note: Waw of consecutive form rendered Then (rule 14).
Fronted question auxiliary belongs to the interrogative particle (rule 17).
Supplied the on the construct noun (rule 29).
Rectum takes of (rule 19).
אִם opening the second disjunctive question takes the fronted auxiliary; the ASV writes no connective for it, the And being the waw's (rule 17).
Indefinite article belongs to the noun (rule 15).
Construct relation 'man of lips' recast as 'full of talk'; the whole relational expression belongs to the rectum (rule 19), headed on talk. Competing reading: head on full.

Hiphil of חרשׁ 'silence' rendered as light verb + complement 'make ... hold their peace'; the idiom's possessive is part of the rendering and the head stays on peace (rule 44). No interrogative particle stands in the clause, so the fronted Should is the verb's own (rule 17).
Coordinator and subordinator written together for one waw, 'And when' (rule 55); headed on the coordinator, competing head on when.
The ASV writes no connective for the second waw (rule 14).

Existential אֵין takes the negation word 'no' and heads on it (rule 50), exactly as the אֵין of JOB.11.19 takes 'none'. The generic 'man' is the anarthrous participle's supplied noun phrase under rule 46, not part of the existential's rendering. Competing reading: 'no man' whole on אֵין as the equivalent of 'none'.

Anarthrous hiphil participle 'one who puts to shame' takes the generic 'man' the ASV supplies to make it a noun phrase (rule 46) together with its light-verb rendering 'make ... ashamed' and the auxiliary; head on the complement ashamed (rule 44). Discontinuous around the negation and the supplied object (rule 25).
Supplied object pronoun; no object morpheme is present (rule 44).

review_notes: Split 'no man': the 'no' is אֵין's negation word (rule 50) and 'man' is the participle's supplied generic noun (rule 46), the smallest defensible allocation under rule 2 and consistent with JOB.11.19's אֵין → none beside its own participle.

alignments.note: Waw rendered For (rule 14).
Copula joins the predicate adjective (rule 20).
הָיָה takes the copula with its subject pronoun (rule 17).
Waw + אוּלָם pair rendered by the single word But, which writes the adverb's own lexeme; the waw is left unrendered (rule 14).

Optative idiom מִי יִתֵּן takes its fixed formula 'oh that' (rules 17, 30); no English word writes either lexeme, so the first source token is the display anchor (rule 6). The modal would is given to the verb it frames; competing reading places would here.
Modal of the volitive frame joins the verb it renders (rule 17).
עִם rendered against.
'And that' is one rendering of the waw continuing the optative (rule 55); headed on the coordinator, competing head on that.
Dative לְ rendered as bare indirect object (rule 40).
Supplied the on the construct (rule 29).
'double' recast as the English predicate 'manifold'; the copula joins the nominal predicate since the ASV writes a separate subject (rules 20, 49). Margin read and set aside.
Waw rendered therefore (rule 14).
ASV reads נשׁה as 'exact'; margin 'causeth to be forgotten' read and set aside (rule 38).
לְ rendered of.
Comparative מִן with degree adverb, headed on than (rule 24).
Referential subject pronoun; no nominal stands earlier in the verse to resume (rules 20, 25).
Supplied lexical verb (rule 20).
Fronted auxiliary belongs to the interrogative particle (rule 17).
Bare nominal 'searching' with supplied preposition by (rule 33). Margin read and set aside.
Rectum promoted to English object; no relational word written.
'find out' keeps its particle (rule 44).
אִם of the second question takes the fronted auxiliary; no connective written for it (rule 17).
Rectum promoted to object with supplied the (rule 15).
Construct 'heights' recast as predicate 'is high' with the construction's copula (rule 20). Margin read and set aside.
Construct relation recast with as; belongs to the rectum (rule 19).
Interrogative מָה holds its own word, so the modal stays with the verb (rule 17).
Referential subject pronoun answering to no morpheme in this verse (rules 20, 25).
Copula joins the predicate adjective (rule 20).
Supplied the belongs to the noun (rule 15).
'pass through' read as one phrasal rendering of חלף (rule 44).
Hiphil 'summon an assembly' rendered 'call unto judgment' as one rendering; headed on the verb carrying the summoning. Margin read and set aside.
Apodosis waw rendered then (rule 14).
Interrogative holds its own word; modal stays with the verb (rule 17).
Rectum rendered attributively (rule 28).
Postposed also belongs to the waw (rule 51).
Waw rendered by the concessive pair 'even though' as one rendering (rules 14, 55); headed on though, competing head on even. Margin read and set aside.
Supplied object pronoun; no object morpheme (rule 44).

ASV recasts the niphal 'get understanding' as 'is void of understanding'; the whole predicate is the verb's rendering, headed on understanding, which writes the lexeme. Competing head: void. Margin read and set aside.
Construct head of the comparison nominal; supplied comparative as goes to the nominal it introduces (rule 33). Competing reading gives as to the possessor phrase it stands before.
Rectum rendered as English possessive; the possessive expression's determiner goes to the possessor (rule 29). 'wild ass' is one lexeme, headed on ass's.
Hiphil כון rendered 'set ... aright', discontinuous (rule 25); headed on the verb, competing head on aright as the complement carrying the directing sense (rule 44).
Prepositional predicate takes the copula (rule 49).
Hiphil רחק as light verb + complement 'put ... far away', headed on far (rule 44).
Hiphil jussive rendered 'let ... dwell', headed on the lexical complement (rule 44).
Asseverative כִּי rendered Surely.
Privative מִן rendered without.
Waw rendered Yea (rule 14).
Finite verb juxtaposed to a written antecedent; the relative is not the verb's (rule 46).
Supplied possessive; no suffix present (rule 18).
Supplied object pronoun (rule 44).
Relative supplied over a finite clause juxtaposed to a written antecedent (rules 46, 55).
Comparative מִן.
Supplied the belongs to the noun (rule 15).
'rise (above)' recast as 'shall be clearer'; the whole predicate is the verb's rendering. Margin 'arise above' read and set aside (rule 38).
Verb 'it will be dark' recast with a presentative frame 'there be darkness'; the dummy belongs to the verb (rule 17).
Paragogic he (rule 32).
Assimilated article takes the written the (rule 12).
Supplied possessive (italic); no suffix present (rule 18).
Subordinator supplied for a clause with no conjunction (rule 55).
Existential יֵשׁ takes the presentative frame (rules 43, 50).
'take thy rest' as light verb + complement with the idiom's possessive (rule 44).
Italic supplied preposition and object; no morpheme licenses either, one added unit (rules 2, 33).
Coordinator supplied for an asyndetic clause (rule 14).
Waw rendered Also (rule 51).
Existential heads on the negation word (rule 50).
Hiphil participle rendered 'make ... afraid', headed on the complement (rule 44); discontinuous around the supplied object.

Idiom חִלָּה פָנִים 'entreat the face' rendered by one expression 'make suit unto', of which no morpheme owns a part (rule 30); headed on the verb. Competing reading: פָּנֶה unrepresented with the phrase on the verb alone.
Supplied object pronoun (rule 44).
Supplied the on the construct (rule 29).
Anarthrous substantival adjective takes its supplied the (rule 46) and the chain's of (rule 19).
'refuge' expanded as 'way to flee'; headed on flee, which writes the lexeme (rule 31). Competing head: way. Margin read and set aside.
'is perished' recast as 'shall have no'; the have and its negation render the verb (rule 43).
'from them' recast as subject; preposition left with nothing (rule 40).
Suffix takes the subject pronoun (rule 40).
Construct predicate takes the copula and its supplied the (rules 20, 29).
Rectum takes of; supplied the belongs to the noun (rules 15, 19).
